verses.arabicText: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

verses.arabicText: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
verses.translation: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajar
verses.translation: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -

verses.arabicText: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu d-dāʿi ilā shayin-nukur
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

verses.arabicText: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādum-muntashir
verses.translation: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

verses.arabicText: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Muh'ṭiʿīna ilā d-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasir
verses.translation: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

verses.arabicText: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnuw-wa-uz'dujir
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

verses.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

verses.arabicText: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
verses.translation: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

verses.arabicText: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.transliteration: Wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudir
verses.translation: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

verses.arabicText: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
verses.translation: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

verses.arabicText: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.translation: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verses.translation: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsim-mus'tamirr
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.arabicText: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
verses.translation: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: Thamud denied the warning

verses.arabicText: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Faqālū abasharam-minnā wāḥidan-nattabiʿuhu innā idhal-lafī ḍalāliw-wasuʿur
verses.translation: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

verses.arabicText: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: A-ul'qiya dh-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashir
verses.translation: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

verses.arabicText: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.translation: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.transliteration: Innā mur'silū n-nāqati fit'natal-lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir
verses.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

verses.arabicText: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bim-muḥ'taḍar
verses.translation: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

verses.arabicText: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.translation: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓir
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of Lot denied the warning.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin-najjaynāhum bisaḥar
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

verses.arabicText: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.transliteration: Niʿ'matam-min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakar
verses.translation: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur
verses.translation: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.translation: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

verses.arabicText: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal mim-muddakir
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzim-muq'tadir
verses.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

verses.arabicText: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: Akuffārukum khayrum-min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī z-zubur
verses.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
verses.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

verses.arabicText: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

verses.arabicText: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.transliteration: Bali s-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarr
verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
verses.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yus'ḥabūna fī n-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqar
verses.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
verses.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣar
verses.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: And everything they did is in written records.

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

verses.arabicText: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
